_comment: P9's mutant set, pre-registered (docs/P9-MUTANTS.md): each mutant is one defect in the pinned nopCommerce source, as a unified diff in this folder, with the contract clauses expected to catch it. Committed with the patches before the first mutant run; intendedClauses is never edited after a result is seen. ASCII only: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads it.

mutants.title: Calibration: no source change
mutants.change: None: the pinned source, built a second time and deployed like every mutant.
mutants.intent: Measures the method, not the contract: two builds of the same code, as two sites on one database, replayed against each other. The verdict must be pass; a run whose M00 is not pass counts no mutant result.

mutants.title: Free shipping from exactly the threshold
mutants.intent: A boundary slip: free shipping over $1,000.00 starts to include $1,000.00 itself, so T26's cart of exactly $1,000.00 is estimated Ground ($0.00).

mutants.title: Coupon code matched case-sensitively
mutants.change: The coupon code comparison, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase, becomes StringComparison.Ordinal.
mutants.intent: The analyzer-driven 'compare ordinally' fix that drops IgnoreCase: the database still finds SAVE10 for ' save10 ' (its collation ignores case), but validation now refuses it, so T12's lower-case coupon is not applied.

mutants.title: Maximum discount amount ignored
mutants.change: The line copying MaximumDiscountAmount into the cached discount model (DiscountForCaching) is dropped.
mutants.intent: A field lost in a port of a mapping: the cap never reaches the discount calculation, so PCT20MAX100 on T15's $3,600.00 cart takes 20% ($720.00) instead of stopping at $100.00.

mutants.title: Order total no longer bounded by the order
mutants.change: The cap of the order total discount at the order total, and both clamps of the order total at zero, are removed.
mutants.intent: Guard clauses lost in a rewrite: TAKE50 on T14's $34.00 order is taken in full ($50.00) and the total goes below zero (-16.00). 3.90 guards the total twice - the discount is capped at the total, then the total is clamped at zero - so removing the clamps alone would change nothing on this traffic; the mutant removes both guards.

mutants.title: Tax from the shipping address instead of the billing address
mutants.change: For TaxBasedOn.BillingAddress the tax request takes customer.ShippingAddress.
mutants.intent: A copy-paste slip in a switch: the store taxes by billing address, and T22F - billed to New York 10001, shipped to Texas - is taxed at Texas's 5% ($25.00) instead of New York's 9% ($45.00).

mutants.title: Tax zip match made case-sensitive
mutants.intent: The same ordinal slip in the tax provider plugin: 'k1a 0b1' no longer matches the rate stored for K1A 0B1, and Ontario has no rate for any zip, so T23 is taxed 0.00 instead of 13% ($65.00).

mutants.title: Order details served without the owner check
mutants.change: _workContext.CurrentCustomer.Id != order.CustomerId is dropped from the condition that refuses the page.
mutants.intent: An authorization check lost in a port of the action: anyone - the guest of T30A, another customer in T30B - gets order 2's details page, owner's name included, instead of the redirect to sign in. The print view, the PDF and the reorder keep their checks.

mutants.title: Unpublished product page served
mutants.change: The 'published?' condition, !product.Published && !AllowViewUnpublishedProductPage, is dropped from the availability check.
mutants.intent: A dropped condition: the unpublished HP Envy's page (T05) answers 200, the product for sale again from an old link, instead of 404.

mutants.title: Stock quantity warning dropped
mutants.change: The 'quantity exceeds stock on hand' warning - some stock left, less than asked for - is removed; the out-of-stock warning stays.
mutants.intent: A lost else branch: T07's add of 5 Lenovos to a cart of 1, with 3 in stock, is accepted, and so is T28's add of 2 with 1 left after the order.

mutants.title: Prices formatted in the invariant culture
mutants.intent: The analyzer-driven 'pass a culture' fix that passes the invariant one: every price loses the currency's own format and is written with the generic currency sign instead of $. Aimed at the cart's unit prices; every clause that reads a formatted amount is expected to fail with them.

mutants.title: Gift-card exclusion dropped from discount validation
mutants.change: The block that refuses order subtotal and order total discounts while the cart holds a gift card is removed.
mutants.intent: A dropped business rule: SAVE10 on T17's cart with a $25 gift card is applied - a subtotal discount of ($4.90) - instead of refused with 'Sorry, this discount cannot be used with gift cards in the cart'.
